# Benjamin Arnedo

> Creative director and designer in Brisbane, Australia. Brand, web and video.

Benjamin Arnedo has worked across brand, web, UX/UI and video for more than 15 years, in Australia and Argentina. He works hands-on from brief through design, build, shoot, edit and delivery. He has run a 9-person studio, led design on 25 to 50 public events a year, and taught design at university level for five years. English and Spanish.
